$description: Gensyn Design data visualization tokens — August 2026. For assessment output, radar charts, score bars, gauges, and any scored artifact.

series.$description: Categorical palette for unordered dimensions. Use in order; do not skip. Beyond six categories, group instead of adding colors.

4.$description: Orange Peel — fills and markers only, never as a label color

5.$description: Rose — shared with the benefits category color

6.$description: Purple Light — sixth and final series color

sequential.$description: Single-hue navy ramp for ordered intensity — heat, density, score magnitude. Steps 1–2 are background fills only; steps 3–5 carry enough contrast for marks and labels.

diverging.$description: Attention-to-strength ramp for gap-against-target and balance scoring. Orange end reads as needs attention, green end as strength, midpoint as neutral.

axis-label.$description: Default axis and tick labels when not series-colored

marker-halo.$description: Ring around markers so they read against any fill

track.$description: Unfilled portion of score bars and progress tracks

fill-opacity.$description: Area and radar fills — keep low so gridlines stay legible
